name: JASS — Japanese Architectural Standard Specification
description: Validates specifications and BOQ items against the Japanese Architectural Standard Specification (JASS) series published by the Architectural Institute of Japan (AIJ). Covers JASS 5 (reinforced concrete), JASS 6 (steel), JASS 8 (waterproofing), JASS 12 (interior finishing), JASS 15 (plastering / tiling), JASS 18 (painting), and JASS 19 (ceramic tiling). Checks that workmanship and quality requirements reference the applicable JASS section.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
